blind_answer.configuration: CLI 2.1.295, effort=high, max-turns=1, 0.50 USD/slot cap, 5 fresh sessions per arm, no tools/MCP/skills/plugins
blind_answer.increment: Blind 0/5 complete vs with-candidate 5/5 complete on the same synthetic compound scenario; candidate supply was the sole difference.

review.rationale: Paired whole-chain comparison on one synthetic compound scenario: blind arm (C2-CLI-ADMISSION-01) delivered 2/5 with 0/5 complete (3 timeouts; both delivered answers failed B3/B4/B9-class evidence/boundary criteria); with-candidate arm (C2-CLI-ADMISSION-02) delivered 5/5 with all B1-B9 met and no hard violation, identical frozen scenario/criteria/system-prompt/CLI configuration. The only prompt difference was the provided candidate content. This is a traceable whole-unit difference for this case; candidate content was independently rewritten (not a copied W card), audited by three static reviewers, and licensed for derivative use (clown upstream Claude-BugHunter: code MIT, content CC BY 4.0, attribution retained). Card was then brought to v2 CARD contract (触发信号/验证或证据/常见误判与停止条件/下一步或晋升 sections, frontmatter deep_refs list); review rebinding covers these structure-only, method-preserving edits.
review.reviewer: Codex (main thread; human-style criterion-by-criterion review of both arms)

three_questions.inferable_from_evidence: Individual facts support individual inferences, but the blind arm failed to organize them into a complete chain meeting all criteria; the gaps match exactly the connections the candidate supplies.
three_questions.model_seen: Training membership unknown; blind arm 0/5 complete shows the current model/configuration does not stably satisfy this whole-chain scenario without the candidate.
three_questions.real_cost_delta: With-candidate 5/5 complete in 3.1–5.1s per slot vs blind 0/5 complete including 3×90s timeouts; measured cost 0.472425 USD for 5 slots of the with-candidate arm.

review.transferability: Method keys on business entry/consumer/ownership facts, not source paths, field values, or host names; scenario-to-target transfer requires separate judgment and is not claimed by this study.
